name: Sipariş Sözleşmeleri for WooCommerce
author: yemlihakorkmaz

sections.description:
This plugin enables you to create distance sales contracts, pre‑information forms, and custom legal contracts according to your requirements in WooCommerce. It automatically fills out these contracts on the checkout page and sends them via email in PDF format.

  • Compatible with WooCommerce’s new block‑based checkout page.
  • Add and edit legal contracts from the admin panel.
  • Insert any desired information into any section of the contract.
  • Automatically generate contracts on the checkout page.
  • Automatically send contracts in PDF format upon order confirmation.
  • View past contracts on both admin and customer order pages.
  • Store emailed PDFs in the uploads folder.

External Services

  • ipify.org – used to retrieve the customer IP address on the checkout form.
    Data sent: HTTP GET request only. Privacy: https://www.ipify.org/privacy-policy
  • yemlihakorkmaz.com/sozlesmeornek.txt – retrieves the default contract template.
    Data sent: none (HTTP GET). Privacy: https://yemlihakorkmaz.com/privacy
sections.installation:
Installing and using the plugin is very easy.

  1. Download the plugin from here or search and install it from your WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Upload and extract the archive into /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Go to Plugins Installed Plugins and click Activate.
  4. In your admin menu you will now see Contracts — add your contracts there.
sections.faq:
Is it completely free to use?

Yes, the plugin is completely free to use. No charges apply.

I don’t want PDFs to be sent via email. How can I disable this?

There’s an option on the plugin settings page to disable this feature.

How can I disable the ID/Tax number section?

There’s an option on the plugin settings page to disable this feature.

I need more support. What should I do?

Send an email to yemlihakorkmaz@hotmail.com.
